title: Neon Pong — 2 Player
description: A neon-styled two-player Pong. Local = left paddle, peer = right paddle. Paddle Y synced every frame; ball physics deterministic with authoritative 10Hz broadcasts.
prompt: A two-player Pong. Each player controls one paddle: the local player is always the LEFT paddle, the peer is the RIGHT paddle. Use VG_RT — on every animation frame send my paddle's Y position with VG_RT.send({y: myPaddleY}), and in VG_RT.on('msg', ({d}) => ...) set the right paddle's Y from d.y. Run the ball physics locally on both clients from a fixed starting seed so they stay roughly in sync; the left player is authoritative for the ball and also sends {ball:{x,y,vx,vy}} ten times a second. Until a second player is present (VG_RT.roster.length < 2), show a centered "Waiting for player 2…" overlay and don't start the ball. Show the peer's nickname (VG_RT.roster) using textContent, never innerHTML. Show each player's ping_ms from the roster in a corner. Restart with R.
